headline: PayPal's Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates on TPV & Revenue Growth
summary: PYPL's Q2 revenues and earnings beat estimates as Venmo and Braintree drive payment growth. Higher investments weighed on margins, while the company raises its 2026 outlook.
